Monitor the patient’s complete blood count (CBC) with differential, hemoglobin (Hgb), hematocrit (Hct), prothrombin time (PT), and partial thromboplastin time (PTT). 2. Administer 250-700 mL of Hespan, to which a citrate anticoagulant has been added, at a ratio of 1:8 to 1:13 to venous whole blood. Monitor CBC with differential, Hgb, Hct, PT, and PTT. 3. For patients with creatinine clearance (CrCl) less than 10 mL/min, after the initial regular dose, reduce subsequent doses by 20-50% of the normal dose. 4. Administer 10 mL/kg per dose, ensuring the total volume does not exceed 20 mL/kg. Infuse 250-700 mL of Hespan at a ratio of 1:8 to 1:13 to venous whole blood. 5. In animal studies involving New Zealand rabbits, BD rats, and Swiss mice, no evidence of teratogenicity was observed when the product was administered intravenously at doses equivalent to 2 times, 1/3 times, and 1 time the maximum recommended therapeutic human dose, respectively, during gestation. 6. It is unknown whether this product is excreted in human milk. Exercise caution when administering this product to nursing women, as many drugs are excreted in human milk. 7. Controlled studies in pregnant women have shown no evidence of fetal risk, making the product generally acceptable for use during pregnancy. 8. Administer at a rate of 2 g/kg/hr (20 mL/kg/hr). Change IV tubing or flush thoroughly with normal saline (NS) before administering blood through the same line. Replace IV tubing at least every 24 hours. 9. Do not administer Hextend with blood through the same administration set. Be prepared for potential anaphylactoid reactions by having epinephrine and resuscitative equipment readily available. 10. Store the product at room temperature and do not freeze it. 11. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 12. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 13. This information is a summary and does not include all possible details about the product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for every individual. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. 14.
